nosotros.desc: We are a digital engineering studio specialized in sub-second web architectures, native mobile apps, and custom business software with full technological sovereignty.
nosotros.historia_p1: At {marca}, we build proprietary technology for organizations that cannot afford slow websites, generic templates, or third-party lock-in. Every platform is built from scratch with clean, scalable, audited code.
nosotros.historia_p2: Under the technical leadership of {fundador} ({universidad}), we integrate enterprise engineering standards, extreme Core Web Vitals optimization, cloud security, and full Git repository handover.
nosotros.historia_p3: We operate with contractual transparency, milestone-based deliverables, and direct engineering support for growing companies and enterprises.
nosotros.mision_desc: Boost each client's digital competitiveness through ultra-fast, secure, scalable proprietary software—eliminating unnecessary monthly rents and operational bottlenecks.
nosotros.vision_desc: Consolidate our position as a leading engineering reference in sub-second web architecture and cloud/mobile solutions with full technological ownership for clients.

valores.desc: Every millisecond impacts SEO and conversion. We design with zero unnecessary JS and instant loading.
Your company owns the code, database, domains, and credentials from day one.
Clean layer separation, maintainable code, and real readiness to scale in traffic and features.
Clear scopes, live staging previews, and direct communication with no intermediaries.

proceso.desc: Technical goal alignment, optimal stack definition, data model, and roadmap.
Clean interfaces focused on conversion, mobile accessibility, and brand consistency.
Modular development, 100/100 performance testing, security, and API/Cloud integrations.
Production launch, technical training, documentation, and full source code delivery.

pilares.desc: Modern architecture tuned to load under 1 second and score 100/100 on Core Web Vitals.
We deliver the full Git repository and master credentials with zero platform lock-in.
Direct coordination with the engineer leading your project from diagnosis to launch.
Real testing, post-delivery support, and formal invoicing for operational peace of mind.

terminos.desc: Clear, transparent, and binding conditions governing contracting, software development, source code delivery, and support at {marca}.

clausulas.texto: Every project begins with a formal technical proposal specifying architecture, modules, deliverables, timeline, and fixed budget.
items: Development starts after written proposal approval and initial milestone payment.
Additional features outside the approved scope are quoted as an independent addendum.
Delivery timelines are counted in business days from receipt of client assets.

clausulas.texto: Unlike agencies that rent templates, we guarantee full technological ownership upon final payment.
items: Full handover of the Git repository, clean source code, and deployment credentials.
Zero forced monthly fees or platform lock-in for using the delivered software.
Brand assets, copy, and media provided by the client remain their exclusive property.

clausulas.texto: We operate with full transparency in USD or PEN through formal payment channels.
items: One-time project payment structured by milestones (kickoff and final production delivery).
Accepted methods: Bank transfer, Yape, Plin, Card, PayPal, and Cash.
Official electronic invoice issued for every payment.

clausulas.texto: We validate quality and speed transparently throughout the build process.
items: Private access to a live staging URL to test responsive design, flows, and performance.
Up to 3 comprehensive review and adjustment rounds before production launch.
Technical optimization aligned with Core Web Vitals and SEO best practices.

clausulas.texto: We stand behind every line of code delivered to ensure your business continuity.
items: 30 calendar days of free warranty against any bug or issue in the delivered code.
Operational training so your team can manage content and panels independently.
Warranty does not cover third-party modifications made after handover.

clausulas.texto: All commercial, financial, database, and access information shared is treated under strict confidentiality.
items: Credentials are used exclusively for authorized setup, deployment, and testing.
We recommend rotating master keys once formal repository handover is complete.

clausulas.texto: These Terms are governed by the applicable laws of the Republic of Peru.
items: Any dispute will first be addressed directly for an amicable resolution.
Competent jurisdiction in the courts of Lima, Peru.

clausulas.texto: We may update these terms to reflect operational or regulatory improvements.
items: For contractual inquiries or legal notices, write directly to {correo}.
In-person appointments by prior scheduling at {sede}.

cookies.desc: At {marca} we respect your privacy. Here we detail the exact local storage keys and cookies used to deliver a fast, secure experience.

clausulas.titulo: What are cookies and local storage?
clausulas.texto: They are small entries saved in your browser (such as LocalStorage or technical cookies) that remember your preferences without hurting speed or privacy.
We only use strictly necessary storage so the app runs in milliseconds: visual theme (Light/Dark), language (ES/EN), and local tool cache.
We never sell or share your browsing history with third-party ad networks. Your usage on our platform stays private.
You can clear or block storage anytime from Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox settings. Questions? Write to {correo}.

filas.proposito: Stores your visual theme preference (Light or Dark) without flicker.
Remembers whether the sidebar is expanded or collapsed.
Restores your last viewed guide in Learn.
Caches your latest local SEO/Speed report for instant reload.

privacidad.desc: At {marca} we protect your personal data and digital assets in strict compliance with applicable data protection regulations.

clausulas.texto: We only request the information needed to quote, execute software projects, issue invoices, and answer inquiries.
items: Name or company name, email address, and contact phone.
Technical project details voluntarily shared by you.

clausulas.texto: Your data is used solely to provide technical support, 1-on-1 consulting, formal billing, and deliverable tracking.
items: We never sell, rent, or transfer databases to third parties.
Zero marketing spam without your prior consent.

clausulas.texto: Operational records are handled over encrypted HTTPS/TLS infrastructure with strict access controls.
items: Client credentials and repositories are safeguarded under professional confidentiality.
Upon handover, we recommend rotating administrative keys.

clausulas.texto: You may exercise your rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Opposition at any time free of charge.
items: Send your request directly to {correo} with your name and request.
In-person support by appointment at {sede}.

contacto.desc: No call centers or middlemen. Coordinate directly with the engineering team at {marca} through your preferred channel.
